attempts.answer:
The vendor directly providing **Todoist** at **todoist.com** is **Todoist Inc.** (also operating under the brand/company name **Doist**).

### Evidence
* **Todoist Terms of Service** (`todoist.com/terms`):
  > *"Welcome, and thank you for your interest in Todoist Inc. (“Todoist,” “we,” “our,” or “us”) and our website at https://www.todoist.com, along with our related websites, networks, applications, mobile applications, and other services provided by us, including, Todoist, Todoist Pro, Todoist Business, Todoist for teams..."*

* **Todoist Privacy Policy** (`todoist.com/privacy`):
  > *"In this Policy, 'Todoist,' 'we,' 'our' or 'us' refers to Todoist Inc., a company registered in Delaware with its registered address located at 251 Little Falls Drive, Wilmington, DE 19808."*

* **App Store Listings**: Both the Apple App Store and Google Play Store officially list the provider and developer of the Todoist application as **Todoist Inc.**
